title: romania adopts new measures boost danube waters cool cernavoda nuclear plant 2026 08 22
text:
WARSAW, Aug 22 (Reuters) - Romania's National Committee for Emergency Situations approved new measures to ​boost the water level of ‌the River Danube and ensure cooling of the Cernavoda nuclear power plant, the ​government press office said on Saturday.
The ​plant remains shut due to historically ⁠low Danube levels and the ​country has declared a state of emergency ​throughout August stemming from a decline in electricity production.
